Pay the visitor’s tax online

The town of Fehmarn offers digital payment of the visitor’s tax (Kurtaxe). Use the link below to pay your visitor’s tax conveniently online. Villa Rosengarten is already pre-filled in the form. You can then print the receipt or save it digitally.
